study_title: Decision Value of Training Evidence: Reanalysis of the National Supported Work Experiment
design: Secondary analysis of the Dehejia-Wahba RE74 subset of the randomized National Supported Work experimental sample
source_name: National Supported Work Demonstration — Dehejia-Wahba RE74 experimental subset
source_description: The source page describes a further subset of LaLonde's NSW experimental data containing RE74 information: 185 treated observations and 260 randomized controls. Variables are treatment, age, education, Black, Hispanic, married, nodegree, RE74, RE75, and RE78.
outcome_note: Published Dehejia-Wahba documentation describes RE78 as real earnings in 1978 measured in 1982 U.S. dollars.
license_note: The NBER-hosted source page states that the data are distributed for attributable non-commercial use (CC BY-NC). The repository stores derived statistics rather than raw participant records.
claim_boundary: Randomization supports a causal treated-control contrast for this historical experimental subset, subject to the original study design. The threshold frontier uses illustrative historical-dollar minimum-benefit scenarios, not observed program costs or validated modern corporate L&D break-even values. Transport to modern corporate training requires separate evidence.
